replace description: Whether to replace these settings from lower-priority packs, or combine them.
enable_completion_with_enter description: Enable completion with `<Enter>` if the current command is known to be incomplete
enforce_show_suggestions_on_slash warnin: It makes command history harder to use
erase_remainder_on_ctrl_space descriptio: Whether to delete input after cursor when accepting a suggestion with <Ctrl> + <Space>
erase_remainder_on_enter description: Whether to delete input after cursor when accepting a suggestion with <Enter>
erase_remainder_on_tab description: Whether to delete input after cursor when accepting a suggestion with <Tab>
erase_remainder_on_left_click descriptio: Whether to delete input after cursor when accepting a suggestion by left-clicking a suggestion
erase_remainder_on_right_click descripti: Whether to delete input after cursor when accepting a suggestion by right-clicking a suggestion
erase_remainder_on_middle_click descript: Whether to delete input after cursor when accepting a suggestion by middle-clicking a suggestion
enable_suggestion_highlighting warning: This requires replacing vanilla rendering of the suggestion list, and may conflict with other mods that do the same
invert_suggestion_order description: Invert the order of suggestions in the suggestion list, so that the most relevant suggestion is the closest to the input bar
include_smart_matches description: Include smart matches, which match segments of the query with initials of parts of the suggestions.
include_weak_matches description: Include weak matches, which search for each query part anywhere on the suggestions, in order
minimum_weak_match_length description: Minimum length of a weak match to be considered
minimum_weak_match_length warning: Setting this to 1 is not a good idea
include_unexpected_suggestions descripti: Include vanilla matches not already matched by other means
